en: A few clouds came along to watch. Also not running.
st: Maru a seng makae a tlile ho shebella. Le ona ha a kenele mabelo.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: A little dust devil is riding ahead of him. It isn't even pedalling.
st: Sefefo se senyenyane sa lerole se mo etella pele. Sona ha se kgatake dipedale le ho hang.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: A proper breeze tonight. The mosquitoes have been grounded.
st: Moya o lekaneng bosiung bona. Menang ha a kgone ho lula fatshe.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: Big wind today. The avo tree is having a clearance sale.
st: Moya o moholo kajeno. Sefate sa avo se rekisa tsohle ka theko e tlase.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: Clear sky this morning. Anyone driving east is doing it from memory.
st: Lehodimo le hlakile hoseng hona. Mang kapa mang ya kgannang a lebile botjhabela o kganna ka hlooho.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: Cloud over the mountain, potjie under the lapa. Both need another hour.
st: Leru hodima thaba, potjie tlasa lapa. Ka bobedi di hloka hora e nngwe.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: Clouds all afternoon, not a drop. The hose is back on duty.
st: Maru thapama yohle, ha ho lerothodi le le leng. Hose e kgutlela mosebetsing.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: Clouds for the sunset, sprinklers for the vines. The farm arranges its own rain.
st: Maru bakeng sa ho dikela ha letsatsi, di-sprinkler bakeng sa merara. Polasi e iketsetsa pula ya yona.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: Cold and wet all day. The furniture has slowly moved closer to the heater.
st: Ho bata ebile ho kolobile letsatsi lohle. Thepa ya ka tlung e atametse heater butle-butle.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: Cold, wet and grey. The car smells of vinegar. Correct.
st: Ho a bata, ho kolobile, ho putswa. Koloi e nkga asene. Ho nepahetse.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: Even the hadeda is keeping it down. The sky set the tone.
st: Esita le hadeda e kgutsitse. Lehodimo le bontshitse tsela.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: Even the people who swear it never gets cold are admitting it.
st: Esita le batho ba hlapanyang hore ha ho mohla ho batang ba a dumela kajeno.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: Every light on the string is swaying. Saturday night has rhythm, barely.
st: Lebone le leng le le leng moleng le a thekesela. Bosiu ba Moqebelo bo na le morethetho, hanyane feela.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: Flags out straight, wine held tight. The deck's version of a calm Monday.
st: Difolaga di otlolohile, veine e tshwerwe ka thata. Ke Mantaha o kgutsitseng ho ya ka deck.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: Frost in the shade. The bus queue has moved into the sun.
st: Serame moriting. Mola wa bese o kene letsatsing.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: Good rain. Oupa's already phoning round: 'How much did you get?'
st: Pula e ntle. Ntatemoholo o se a letsetsa bohle: 'Le fumane bokae?'
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: Grey sky, jerseys on, school's out. The weekend doesn't need the sun's permission.
st: Lehodimo le putswa, di-jersey di apere, sekolo se tswile. Mafelo a beke ha a hloke tumello ya letsatsi.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: Half moon, half cloud, full bin. Tuesday night, as advertised.
st: Halofo ya kgwedi, halofo ya leru, bin e tletse. Bosiu ba Labobedi, jwalo ka ha ho boletswe.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: Half the stars are behind cloud. The fairy lights are covering for them.
st: Halofo ya dinaledi e ka mora maru. Mabone a manyane a a di emela.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: Hand on the cap, one stride at a time. The breeze is pacing her.
st: Letsoho hodima kepisi, mohato ka mohato. Moya o mo behela lebelo.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: Hot enough that the ref's calling a water break every ten minutes.
st: Ho tjhesa hoo moahlodi a bitsang phomolo ya metsi metsotso e meng le e meng e leshome.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: In and out of the sun all day, then this. We all know someone like that.
st: Letsatsi le ne le kena le tswa letsatsi lohle, mme jwale sena. Bohle re tseba motho ya jwalo.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: It's 6am and the fridge is already the most popular room in the house.
st: Ke hora ya botshelela hoseng mme fridge e se e le kamore e ratwang ka ho fetisisa ka tlung.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: It's looked like rain since breakfast. Still just looking.
st: Esale ho shebahala eka pula e tla na ho tloha dijong tsa hoseng. E ntse e shebahala feela.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: Moon behind a cloud, dog on the stoep. Sunday's service is over.
st: Kgwedi ka mora leru, ntja stoepong. Tshebeletso ya Sontaha e fedile.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: Mostly sunny. Except over your garden.
st: Boholo ba nako ho na le letsatsi. Ntle le hodima serapa sa hao.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: No shadows, no glare, no excuses. Monday under a Tupperware lid.
st: Ha ho meriti, ha ho kganya, ha ho mabaka. Mantaha tlasa sekwahelo sa Tupperware.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: Not a cloud all day. The only tree in the car park is now prime property.
st: Ha ho leru letsatsi lohle. Sefate se le seng feela sebakeng sa ho paka se se se le thepa ya bohlokwa.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: Not one shadow on the field all day. The umpire never had to squint.
st: Ha ho moriti le o mong lebaleng letsatsi lohle. Moahlodi ha a ka a ba le bothata ba kganya.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: One cloud over the mountain is not a weather event. The fire stays lit.
st: Leru le le leng hodima thaba hase ketsahalo ya boemo ba lehodimo. Mollo o ntse o tuka.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: Proper gale tonight. If you're towing a caravan, the caravan is driving.
st: Moya o matla haholo bosiung bona. Haeba o hula caravan, caravan ke yona e kgannang.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: Proper heat this afternoon. Even the candles can't stand up straight.
st: Mocheso wa nnete thapama ena. Esita le dikerese ha di kgone ho ema di otlolohile.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: Properly cold today. The kind that goes through three jerseys like they aren't there.
st: Ho bata ka nnete kajeno. Serame se kenang di-jersey tse tharo eka ha di eo.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: Purple on the ground, white in the sky. Friday's colour scheme is approved.
st: Pherese fatshe, bosweu lehodimong. Mebala ya Labohlano e amohetswe.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: Raining all night. The sprinkler hasn't noticed.
st: Pula e na bosiu bohle. Sprinkler ha e eso lemohe.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: Sea and sky in matching grey. Only the pier lights made an effort.
st: Lewatle le lehodimo di putswa ka ho tshwana. Ke mabone a pier feela a entseng boiteko.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: Shoes on the blanket corners. The breeze is welcome, the sand isn't.
st: Dieta di tshwere kobo hore e se ke ya fofa. Moya o a amohelwa, lehlabathe ha le amohelwe.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: Sky and sea agreed on a colour this morning. Not an exciting one.
st: Lehodimo le lewatle di dumellane ka mmala hoseng hona. Ha se o thabisang.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: Somebody forgot the washing. The breeze didn't, and it's doing a lovely job.
st: Motho e mong o lebetse diaparo tse hlatswitsweng. Moya ha o a lebala, mme o etsa mosebetsi hantle.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: Steady breeze from next door's braai. You get everything but the meat.
st: Moya o tsitsitseng o tswa ho braai ya baahisane. O fumana tsohle ntle le nama.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: Sun's in, sun's out. Monday's doing a soft launch.
st: Letsatsi le a kena, le a tswa. Mantaha o qala butle.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: Sunglasses on, sunglasses off, sunglasses on. Friday afternoon is interval training.
st: Di-sunglasses ho apara, ho hlobola, ho apara. Thapama ya Labohlano ke boikwetliso.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: The breeze does all the work. The kite takes all the credit.
st: Moya o etsa mosebetsi wohle. Khaete e nka tlotla yohle.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: The breeze is moving the jacaranda one street over, petal by petal. The stoep approves.
st: Moya o isa jacaranda seterateng se latelang, lekgasi ka lekgasi. Stoep e a dumela.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: The breeze is still warm at this hour. The sea leaves the heating on all night.
st: Moya o ntse o futhumetse ka nako ena. Lewatle le siya heater e butswe bosiu bohle.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: The breeze is taking the smoke down the block. The whole street knows what's for supper.
st: Moya o isa mosi tlase seterateng. Seterata kaofela se tseba hore ho jewang mantsiboya.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: The clouds are drifting through slowly. It's Sunday; they're allowed.
st: Maru a feta butle-butle. Ke Sontaha; a dumelletswe.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: The clouds are passing the moon around. The balcony is happy to wait.
st: Maru a bapala ka kgwedi. Balcony e thabela ho ema.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: The clouds gave the sun Tuesday off. Nobody told the humidity.
st: Maru a file letsatsi phomolo ka Labobedi. Ha ho ya boleletseng mongobo.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: The clouds stayed late just for the colour. Monday owed everyone that much.
st: Maru a diehile feela bakeng sa mebala. Mantaha o ne a re kolota seo.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: The clouds turned pink right on packing-up time. Nobody packed up.
st: Maru a fetohile pinki hantle nakong ya ho phutha thoto. Ha ho ya phuthileng.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: The corner flag is pointing out exactly where the conversions will drift.
st: Folaga ya hukung e bontsha hantle moo bolo e tla kgelohela teng.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: The dog found the exact line between sun and shade. He's staying put.
st: Ntja e fumane mola o nepahetseng pakeng tsa letsatsi le moriti. E dula moo.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: The dust is going for gold in the low light. The match plays on through it.
st: Lerole le kganya jwalo ka kgauta leseding le tlase. Papadi e tswela pele ka hare ho lona.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: The flag's giving the forecast before the surfers do. It says: go.
st: Folaga e fana ka ponelopele pele ho ba-surfer. E re: tsamayang.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: The flags are still chatting. The boats have called it a week.
st: Difolaga di ntse di qoqa. Diketswana di phethile beke.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: The hadedas are heading home early. Follow them.
st: Dihadeda di ya hae kapele. Di latele.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: The hill is moving in waves. The cattle have decided not to notice.
st: Leralla le tsamaya ka maqhubu. Dikgomo di nkile qeto ya ho se lemohe.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: The jacaranda petals are taking the bus too. The breeze bought their tickets.
st: Makgasi a jacaranda le ona a palama bese. Moya o a rekeletse ditekete.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: The leaves keep setting off the security light. The dog's stopped getting up for them.
st: Makgasi a ntse a bonesa lebone la tshireletso. Ntja e se e kgaotse ho tsoha bakeng sa ona.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: The moon drops in between clouds. It can smell the meat from up there.
st: Kgwedi e hlaha pakeng tsa maru. E kgona ho nkga nama ho tswa hodimo kwana.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: The moon keeps popping out to check on the forecourt. Still nothing happening.
st: Kgwedi e ntse e hlaha ho tla hlahloba forecourt. Ha ho letho le etsahalang.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: The moon's on a dimmer tonight. The security light has no such setting.
st: Kgwedi e fokotsehile leseding bosiung bona. Lebone la tshireletso lona ha le tsebe ho fokotseha.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: The mountain pulled the duvet over its head. Fair enough, it's Friday.
st: Thaba e ikwahetse kobo hlooho. Ho lokile, ke Labohlano.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: The sand is crossing the road a grain at a time. Nobody here is in a hurry.
st: Lehlabathe le tshela tsela butle-butle. Ha ho motho ya potlakileng mona.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: The security light came on early. The sun never properly clocked in.
st: Lebone la tshireletso le qadile ho kganya kapele. Letsatsi ha le a ka la fihla mosebetsing hantle.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: The shade is working down the rows one at a time. It's inspecting.
st: Moriti o theoha mela ka mola. O a hlahloba.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: The shed bulb is tonight's sunset. The cattle accept the downgrade.
st: Lebone la shede ke ho dikela ha letsatsi bosiung bona. Dikgomo di amohela phokotso eo.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: The sheets are dry already. Now the breeze is just showing off for the kid.
st: Dilakane di se di omme. Jwale moya o iponahatsa feela bakeng sa ngwana.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: The sky went from light grey to dark grey. That was the whole show.
st: Lehodimo le fetohile ho tloha ho putswa bo bobebe ho ya ho putswa bo lefifi. Ke yona pontsho yohle.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: The sky's on mute and so is the queue. Monday hasn't found the volume.
st: Lehodimo le kgutsitse, le mola o kgutsitse. Mantaha ha a eso fumane modumo.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: The sky's putting on a show. The fish, as usual, are not.
st: Lehodimo le bontsha pontsho. Ditlhapi, jwalo ka mehla, ha di etse jwalo.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: The smoke has found the neighbours' yard. Saturday's braai is officially a community event.
st: Mosi o fumane jarete ya baahisane. Braai ya Moqebelo ke ketsahalo ya setjhaba ka molao.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: The sun didn't show for sundowners. Everyone else did.
st: Letsatsi ha le a ka la hlaha bakeng sa di-sundowner. Bohle ba bang ba tlile.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: The sun won't be inspecting the shine today. The car is fine with that.
st: Letsatsi le ke ke la hlahloba ho benya kajeno. Koloi e kgotsofetse ke seo.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: The sun's clocked out. The clouds are still lit, and so is the balcony.
st: Letsatsi le phethile mosebetsi. Maru a ntse a kganya, le balcony e ntse e kganya.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: The washing should have come in hours ago. The breeze voted to leave it.
st: Diaparo di ne di lokela ho kenngwa dihora tse fetileng. Moya o voutetse hore di sale.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: The washing will be dry before first break. The breeze took the early shift.
st: Diaparo di tla be di omme pele ho phomolo ya pele. Moya o nkile shift ya hoseng.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: The whole veld with the colour turned down. The sheep count the same either way.
st: Naha yohle e fokoditswe mebala. Dinku di balwa ka ho tshwana ho sa tsotellehe.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: The windpump doesn't believe in knock-off time. Neither does the dog.
st: Pompo ya moya ha e dumele nakong ya ho tlohela mosebetsi. Le ntja ha e dumele.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: The windpump is doing the morning's work. The grass is just waving it on.
st: Pompo ya moya e etsa mosebetsi wa hoseng. Jwang bo e kgothatsa feela.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: Thick mist on the dam this morning. The fish have the same view as you.
st: Mohodi o motenya letamong hoseng hona. Ditlhapi di bona se tshwanang le seo o se bonang.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: Thick mist this morning. The spiders have been busy all along.
st: Mohodi o motenya hoseng hona. Dikgo di ne di ntse di sebetsa nako yohle.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)

en: Those clouds are only passing through. Even the mealies know not to get excited.
st: Maru ao a feta feela. Esita le poone e a tseba hore e se ke ya thaba haholo.
note: Sesotho, SA orthography (review/st-voice.md); drafted after Sesotho passed the re-run October exam (review/sesotho-exam-fix-2026-10-14.md)
